scope: Candidate-level evidence audit only, prior to any prediction or target reveal
coffee_protocol: Use only the PDF page 11 Fig. 6(b) right-panel placements. Check both axes and count a trace point only if an independent glyph or another primary observation distinguishes it from a connecting line. For an absolute-capacitance trace, same-test C0 and normalization must be independently justified before retention features are produced.
pomelo_protocol: Use native PDF panels already fingerprinted in P32 and compare to the conservative archive-thumbnail windows. Check separate symbols and material identities. Keep possible overlaps, frame contacts and unstated sampling unresolved.
output_whitelist: Allowed metadata and early-region geometric diagnostics. Permit early numeric points only after clear marker, axis and sample binding. Do not export full article text or panels, post-window data, terminal capacitance, reported retention or differences that disclose it.
formal_evaluation: Keep original feature and source-isolation gates. No fitting or independent acceptance planned in this evidence round. Preserve all unresolved candidates.
